# myArc

> A pre-release open-source browser project inspired by Arc, built on Chromium with a Rust-owned workspace core.

A complete myArc browser and importer remain unimplemented. Native integration is experimental. Arc reference screenshots illustrate the target appearance. Local ownership and optional AI are product requirements, not evidence of a finished release.

## Project

- [Overview](https://myarc.dev/index.md): Markdown equivalent of the homepage.
- [Progress journal](https://myarc.dev/blog/index.md): Published development updates.
- [Download](https://myarc.dev/download/index.md): Pre-alpha nightly status, requirements and known limitations.
- [Repository](https://github.com/bitbonsai/myarc): Public source and plans.

## Posts

- [Why myArc is now GPL-3.0](https://myarc.dev/blog/2026-10-29-gpl/index.md): myArc moved from the MIT license to GPL-3.0 so it stays open for good. I don't plan to make money from it, and any modified version has to publish its code.
- [Building myArc in public](https://myarc.dev/blog/2026-10-25-building-in-public/index.md): Why I'm building myArc after Arc's sunset announcement, with account-free browsing, no behavioral tracking and an Artcraft-inspired workflow.
